title: MC 407: Ambulatory Care Facilities and Group I-2 Occupancies
officialText:
407.1 General.

Mechanical ventilation for ambulatory care facilities (Group B) and Group I-2 occupancies shall be designed and installed in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local regulations.
